title: CLCON/523/2020 of GEETA JAIN Vs NAVEEN KUMAR

paras.text:
CLCON No.523 of 2020
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.

Mr. Pankaj Kaushik, Advocate for the petitioner.
The counsel for the petitioner undertakes to
remove the defect pertaining to the non supply of the
sufficient Court fees.
The said prayer is granted.
Petitioner may remove the defect within a period
of one week from today.
The counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw
the present contempt petition.
The contempt petition is dismissed as withdrawn
subject to the deposit of the deficiency of the Court
fees, as narrated above.
